redirectProbe.method: GET /auth/v1/verify with a deliberately invalid synthetic token, type=signup and requested app return origin

interpretation: The deployed app return is not accepted by current Auth redirect configuration, which falls back to localhost. No app code redirects users to the Supabase developer dashboard.
requiredOperatorConfiguration: Set Auth Site URL and allowed return URLs to the deployed GRIDIRON AI origin, preserving existing authorized destinations.
scopeLimitation: Available Supabase management tools do not expose Auth URL configuration mutation. No security setting was disabled or bypassed.
unaffectedFlows: Password sign-in for an already confirmed GRIDIRON AI account
